title: Taking 'a headframe lantern, unlit' at The Head-Frame (Iron Downs) showed no '(NPC watching: taking it is theft...)' warning like every other pickup with a witness in the game, yet it silently counted as theft and cost Tamsin's regard (-1) immediately after.
